en: Fixed plugins from the official marketplace being recorded without their commit in `installed_plugins.json`, and `installed_plugins.json` keeping the old commit after updating a pinned-commit plugin
zh: 修复了来自官方 marketplace 的 plugin 在 `installed_plugins.json` 中记录时缺少其 commit 的问题，以及更新固定 commit 的 plugin 后 `installed_plugins.json` 仍保留旧 commit 的问题
